shared.description: This blade focuses the power of nature itself through it! You can upgrade this weapon at the Black Market Moglin.
shared.notes:
Weapons cannot be destroyed.
Level 30-90 versions of this weapon have Mana flavor resistance.
Special effects, as per the August 4th, 2015 and September 3rd, 2021 Design Notes:
  • quote:
If you have the Weapon equipped.
  • If the enemy race is "Plant" then it will weakness seek and increase all damage by 5%.
  • If the enemy race is "Fungus" then it will weakness seek and increase BtH by 10%.
  • If enemy resistance to Nature > 0 then it will weakness seek.
If you have either the Helm or Cape equipped, or both.
  • If the enemy race is "Beast" then it will weakness seek and increase BtH by 20%.
  • If the enemy race is "Bug" then it will weakness seek and increases chance of a Crit on hit by 5%.
  • If the enemy race is "Giantkind" then it will weakness seek and increase all damage by 6%.
If you have the Helm and Blade equipped.
  • Increases chance of a Crit on hit by 5%.
If you have the Cape and Blade equipped.
  • Increases BtH by 5%.
If you have the Helm and Cape and Blade equipped.
  • Increases chance of a Crit on hit by 8% and BtH by 10%
  • These stack to an effect as well. So if you have the Cape equipped to get the trigger bonus you not only get the +5% BtH but you also get the Beast, Bug, and Giantkind effects as well! The only exception to this is if the enemy has a resistance to Nature AND is one of the race types. The blade will pick the special based on the race of the monster before it attempts to use the Nature Resistance special. (Since the race specials are a lot stronger it makes sense not to have one of them overwritten!)
All weakness seeking effects require the weapon to be equipped to activate.

shared.description: This scythe was forged by Dracelix to celebrate the New Year! Overflowing with New Year's spirit, it has a chance on-hit to set off spiritworks on your enemy for 5 turns.
shared.notes:
Weapons cannot be destroyed.
Weapons are animated; the magenta flames flicker, magenta droplets spin in a circular motion around the gem, and the blade crackles with energy.

name: Spellsword's Legacy, The
description: Back in the days of Hawkscry's peak, a powerful spellsword forged this beautiful weapon by her own hands. Like so much else, it was thought to be lost to ruin... Click to change grip. (Cosmetic)(CC: Base, Trim, Element)
notes:
Weapon is animated; the runic circle rotates continuously.
Weapon is color-custom; the handle is linked to the player's base color; description erroneously states the weapon is also linked to the player's trim color.
Weapon's appearance is attuned to the player's equipped weapon's element; refer to this chart for all appearances.
Click anywhere on the weapon to change its orientation between facing backwards or forwards.

name: Sphere of Elemental Power
description:

 (Cosmetic)
notes:
Weapon's appearance is attuned to the player's equipped weapon's element; refer to this chart for all appearances.
Click anywhere on the weapon to reposition it through a total of 10 different positions.
Wood elemental attunement became accessible upon the release of Spare Chair on January 28th, 2023.

shared.description: Seven elemental choices for seven years of DragonFable! Visit the Black Market Moglin to upgrade this weapon. This item requires a Dragon Amulet.
shared.notes:
Weapons are animated; the wheels rotate continuously; weapons also have unique animations for each available element:
  • In all appearances, the half Water Orb's water runs, the Energy Orb crackles with energy, and the Darkness Orb's purple markings rise continuously.
  • In Water/Ice appearance, the blade sparkles periodically.
  • In Wind appearance, the blade shimmers periodically.
  • In Fire appearance, flames flicker across the dragon's head and the blade continuously, and markings on the blade pulse continuously.
  • In Stone appearance, rocks float and spin near the blade continuously.
  • In Light appearance, the wing near the dragon's head flickers with yellow flames, and the blade emits orbs of light periodically.
  • In Energy appearance, the horn on the dragon's head and the blade crackle with energy continuously, and energy runs through the blade periodically.

shared.description: Seven choices for seven years of DragonFable! Visit the Black Market Moglin to upgrade this weapon.
shared.notes:
Weapons are animated; the wheels rotate continuously; weapons also have unique animations for each available element:
  • In all appearances, the half Water Orb's water runs, the Energy Orb crackles with energy, and the Darkness Orb's purple markings rise continuously.
  • In Water/Ice appearance, the blade sparkles periodically.
  • In Wind appearance, the blade shimmers periodically.
  • In Fire appearance, flames flicker across the dragon's head and the blade continuously, and markings on the blade pulse continuously.
  • In Stone appearance, rocks float and spin near the blade continuously.
  • In Light appearance, the wing near the dragon's head flickers with yellow flames, and the blade emits orbs of light periodically.
  • In Energy appearance, the horn on the dragon's head and the blade crackle with energy continuously, and energy runs through the blade periodically.
  • In Darkness appearance, the blade emits skulls of darkness continuously, and the black doom threads on the dragon's head wiggle continuously.
Click on the weapon's orbs to change between its available elements (Water/Ice is random); this will also change its appearance; weapons are animated between transitions, and the selected element's orb shimmers periodically. (Pop-up: <Element>!)

shared.notes:
Formula for temporary weapon damage:
  • quote:
Average damage formula: SQRT(Level)*10, rounded down; min/max damage values are generated randomly by subtracting/adding a value between 1 and 4 inclusive.
If you have Mage equipped when obtained, weapon will be a Staff item type dealing only Magic damage type.
If you have Rogue equipped when obtained, weapon will be a Dagger item type dealing only Melee damage type.
Weapon has a very low drop rate.
Weapons' special does not stack with Frozen Claymore, Frozen Dagger, Frozen Mace, Frozen Wand, Glaive of Eternal Peace, High-Tech Turducken Carver, Hive Ranger's Halberd, or Ice Scythe's specials.
Weapons are animated; white shimmers appear continuously and the katana pulses with a bright white glow continuously.
The following changes were implemented on April 22nd, 2020:
  • Special's -Ice Resist was modified from -100 Ice Resist to target for 49 turns inclusive to -30 Ice Resist to target for 5 turns inclusive.
  • Special's damage was increased 100% damage to 200% damage.
  • Activation rate was increased from 5% to 20%.
Special's damage was increased from 200% to 300% on January 29th, 2021.
The following changes were implemented on September 8th, 2023:
  • Special now requires to land its hit to activate its -Ice effect.
  • -Ice Resist value was reduced from -30 to -10 Ice Resist.
  • Damage was reduced from 300% to 200%.
  • A +10 Fire Resist effect was added.
50-80 versions' names were tiered with Roman numerals on February 8th, 2025.

weaponSpecial.trigger: Your weapon special activates on hit.
weaponSpecial.effect: Applies 'Spirit of Envy' or 'Spirit of Greed', a 40% Magic Poison/Energy weapon damage DoT effect, to target for 5 turns. (Rate: 10%)

notes:
Click the weapon to change between its available elements; this will also change its appearance; weapon is animated between transitions. (Pop-up: Wheel element shifts to <Poison/Energy>.)
'Spirit of Envy' is used if this weapon's current element is Poison while 'Spirit of Greed' is used if this weapon's current element is Energy.
Special's DoT is mutually exclusive with the following DoT effects from the following weapons:
  • 'DOOM': Corrupt ShadowReaper of Doom, Corrupt Skullstaff of Doom, Corrupt Twin Blades of Doom, Unreal ShadowReaper of Doom, Unreal Skullstaff of Doom, Unreal Twin Blades of Doom
  • 'Destiny': Penultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Penultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Penultimate Twin Blades of Destiny, Ultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Ultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Ultimate Twin Blades of Destiny
  • 'Destroyer's Spirit': Var'Dolaas
  • All other 'Spirit' effects: Brave Blade, Bright Star Staff, Dagger of Unity, Decus, Ferocitas, Fidelitas, Freedom, Independence, Liberty, Mace of the North, Pick of the North, Staff of the North, Staff of Unity, Star Spangled Sword, Sword of Unity
Weapon's default element became Poison on July 7th, 2026.
